data.title: 莲华 · 桧木温泉畔的枫叶月夜冷泉
data.description: 深山秘汤温泉旅馆庭园内，蒸腾雾气在清冷月光下袅袅升起。莲华身披宽松浅青浴衣坐在桧木池畔，白皙双足浸入温润泉水中，飘落的红枫在水面荡起层层涟漪。
data.location: tranquil outdoor cedar hot spring pavilion surrounded by red maple trees under full moon
data.action: sitting elegantly on hot spring edge, feet dipped in steaming water, watching floating maple leaf, serene introspective expression
data.lighting: 清冷满月光华与温泉池畔地灯
data.promptProse: Renge sits at the cedar edge of an outdoor hot spring dipping her bare feet, watching crimson maple leaves drift across moonlit waters.
data.animaCaption: Steam rises through pale moonlight as fallen maple leaves circle around her feet.
